title: testimony — vowel

phrases.translation: 专家证词；鉴定人证据；专家作证

sentences.sentence: Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
sentences.translation: 巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。

sentences.sentence: In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
sentences.translation: 他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

phrases.translation: n. 高铝水泥；快干水泥；矾土水泥

sentences.sentence: Methods outlined in the monograph include: use of crushed clay pots, bone charcoal, contact precipitation, or use of activated alumina (absorptive filter).

sentences.sentence: In this depiction of the rod-shaped E. coli, two flagella trail from one end while hairlike pili surround a capsule full of tangled nucleoids.
sentences.translation: 在创作这个杆状的大肠杆菌时，其表现出的形式为一端甩出两条鞭毛，同时细微的菌毛围绕在布满凌乱菌核的荚膜上。

sentences.sentence: Lungs are more complex than either of these organs, containing several different cell types that form delicate, hairlike capillaries and a maze of branching air sacs.
sentences.translation: 但是肺的复杂性要超过这两种器官，肺里有几种不同的细胞，要分别形成细微的、头发丝一样的毛细血管，和迂回曲折的分支状的气囊。

sentences.translation: 我的小儿子三岁。

sentences.translation: 算他走运，不在犯罪现场的证据无懈可击。

sentences.sentence: Unless the ban is watertight, EU laws will overturn it.
sentences.translation: 这条禁令除非是十分严密，否则会被欧盟法律推翻。

sentences.sentence: philosophers who accept scientific rationalism
sentences.translation: 接受科学唯理论的哲学家们

sentences.sentence: There is a willful self-destructiveness in the air here as if America has all the time and money in the world for petty politics.
sentences.translation: 这里的空气里中弥漫着一种故意自我毁灭的气息，为了狭隘的政治，美国好像在全世界有的是金钱和时间。

sentences.sentence: Even the best ones can be foiled, though, by a sufficiently willful programmer committed to ignoring basic principles of memory management.
sentences.translation: 但是，即使最优秀的编程人员也可能会被忽略内存管理基本原则的非常任性的编程人员搅乱。

phrases.translation: 信贷可靠性；信誉；信贷价值

sentences.sentence: So we must ask what lends objective worthiness to a life outside the moral realm.
sentences.translation: 所以在道德范畴之外，我们必须设问，是什么东西带给人生客观性的值得。

sentences.sentence: Some find popularity and artistic worthiness to be opposites and therefore, reject bands that become successful.
sentences.translation: 一些人发现流行程度和艺术价值是对立的，因此否定那些逐步成功的乐队。

sentences.sentence: Barack and Michelle Obama are also a more fully fused political team than ever before, with no other jobs to distract them, no doubts about the worthiness of the pursuit dogging them.
sentences.translation: 因为没有其他工作让他们分心，也毫不怀疑他们追求的事业的价值，所以巴拉克和米歇尔·奥巴马比以往任何时候都更加融洽。

translations.translation: 狭隘道德观的, 说教的

sentences.sentence: It’s difficult to talk to teenagers about drugs without sounding too moralistic.
sentences.translation: 跟青少年谈论毒品，又不能有太重的说教味道，这是很难的。

sentences.sentence: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
sentences.translation: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

sentences.sentence: a conscientious and hard-working student
sentences.translation: 勤勉刻苦的学生

sentences.sentence: His grammar and syntax, both in oral and written expression, were much better than the average.
sentences.translation: 无论在口头还是笔头上，他的语法和句法都非常出众。

sentences.sentence: ‘I’m a prisoner in my own home.’ ‘Nonsense!’
sentences.translation: “我在自己家里就像个囚犯。”“胡说！”

sentences.sentence: If you ask me, these modern teaching methods are a load of nonsense (= a lot of nonsense ).
sentences.translation: 要我说，这些现代教学方法全是一派胡言。

sentences.sentence: He was talking utter nonsense as usual.
sentences.translation: 他像平常一样又在胡说八道了。

sentences.sentence: By 1832 the idea had become an economic nonsense.
sentences.translation: 到了1832年，那种观点已经成为经济学的谬论。

sentences.translation: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

sentences.sentence: a woman’s decision on whether or not to terminate the pregnancy
sentences.translation: 女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

sentences.sentence: a playful little dog
sentences.translation: 活泼的小狗

sentences.sentence: Babies are playful and alert when they first wake up.
sentences.translation: 宝宝们刚醒来的时候很好动，而且反应敏捷。

sentences.sentence: discontinuity in economic development
sentences.translation: 经济发展的间断性

sentences.sentence: a prosaic writing style
sentences.translation: 乏味的写作风格

sentences.sentence: The reality, however, is probably more prosaic.
sentences.translation: 然而，事实很可能更平淡无奇。

sentences.sentence: laws to prevent discrimination
sentences.translation: 防止歧视的法律

sentences.sentence: But he could say vowel clearly and began to learn vocabulary.
sentences.translation: 但是他已经能清楚地说元音并开始学习词汇。

sentences.sentence: Always end the name of your child with a vowel, so that when you yell the name will carry.
sentences.translation: 一定让孩子的名字以元音结尾，这样当你喊叫时，这样的名字会助你一臂之力。

sentences.sentence: Towards the end of Middle English, a sudden and distinct change in pronunciation (the Great Vowel Shift) started, with vowels being pronounced shorter and shorter.
sentences.translation: 随着中世纪英语的泯灭，发音突然发生了很大的变化（元音大推移），元音的发音越来越短。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 406 单元

testimony
音标：英 /'testɪmənɪ/  美 /'tɛstə'moni/
n. 证词, 宣言
短语：expert testimony — 专家证词；鉴定人证据；专家作证
短语：bear testimony to — 证明；担保
例句：Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。
例句：In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

alumina
音标：英 /ə'luːmɪnə/  美 /ə'lumɪnə/
n. [化]氧化铝(亦称矾土)
短语：alumina powder — n. 氧化铝粉；铝土粉
短语：alumina ceramics — 氧化铝陶瓷；高铝陶瓷
短语：fused alumina — [化]熔融氧化铝
短语：activated alumina — 活性氧化铝
短语：alumina fiber — 氧化铝纤维
短语：alumina cement — n. 高铝水泥；快干水泥；矾土水泥
短语：calcined alumina — 煅烧氧化铝
短语：high alumina cement — 高铝水泥
短语：alumina brick — 矾土砖；高铝砖
例句：Methods outlined in the monograph include: use of crushed clay pots, bone charcoal, contact precipitation, or use of activated alumina (absorptive filter).
专著中概述的方法包括：使用粗砂壶、骨炭、接触沉淀，或使用活性氧化铝（吸收型过滤器）。

hairlike
adj. 毛一般的, 细微的
例句：In this depiction of the rod-shaped E. coli, two flagella trail from one end while hairlike pili surround a capsule full of tangled nucleoids.
在创作这个杆状的大肠杆菌时，其表现出的形式为一端甩出两条鞭毛，同时细微的菌毛围绕在布满凌乱菌核的荚膜上。
例句：Lungs are more complex than either of these organs, containing several different cell types that form delicate, hairlike capillaries and a maze of branching air sacs.
但是肺的复杂性要超过这两种器官，肺里有几种不同的细胞，要分别形成细微的、头发丝一样的毛细血管，和迂回曲折的分支状的气囊。

coating
音标：英 /'kəʊtɪŋ/  美 /'kotɪŋ/
n. 被覆, 衣料
短语：powder coating — 粉末涂料；粉末涂敷
短语：coating technology — 涂料技术
短语：coating process — 涂层工艺；裹贴法
短语：coating material — 涂料；涂层材料；饰面材料；覆盖材料
短语：surface coating — 表面涂层
短语：coating thickness — 涂膜厚度
短语：ceramic coating — 陶瓷涂层
短语：spray coating — [化]喷涂
短语：coating machine — 涂布机；镀膜机；糖衣机
短语：film coating — [化]涂膜；薄膜敷层
短语：protective coating — 保护涂层；防护涂料
短语：coating system — 涂料体系
短语：zinc coating — 镀锌；镀锌层；镀锌制品
短语：epoxy coating — 环氧尸涂层；环氧树脂涂层
短语：coating agent — n. 涂层剂，涂布剂；覆盖剂
短语：polyurethane coating — 聚氨酯涂料；聚氨酯敷层
短语：paper coating — 纸张涂料；纸面涂布；纸上涂胶；纸面涂膜
短语：metal coating — 金属镀层法；金属镀层；包镀金属；金属敷层
短语：plastic coating — 塑料涂层；塑料涂膜
短语：electrophoretic coating — 电镀；电泳涂敷；电泳喷涂

wee
音标：英 /wiː/  美 /wi/
adj. 很少的, 微小的
短语：wee hours — 凌晨
例句：My wee boy is three.
我的小儿子三岁。

watertight
音标：英 /'wɔːtətaɪt/  美 /'wɔtɚtaɪt/
adj. 不漏水的, 无懈可击的
例句：Lucky for him, his alibi is watertight.
算他走运，不在犯罪现场的证据无懈可击。
例句：Unless the ban is watertight, EU laws will overturn it.
这条禁令除非是十分严密，否则会被欧盟法律推翻。

rationalism
音标：英 /'ræʃ(ə)n(ə)lɪz(ə)m/  美 /'ræʃnə'lɪzəm/
n. 理性主义, 唯理论
例句：philosophers who accept scientific rationalism
接受科学唯理论的哲学家们

willful
音标：英 /'wɪlfʊl/  美 /'wɪlfəl/
adj. 任性的, 故意的
短语：willful misconduct — 故意的不良行为 条约法律；渎职
例句：There is a willful self-destructiveness in the air here as if America has all the time and money in the world for petty politics.
这里的空气里中弥漫着一种故意自我毁灭的气息，为了狭隘的政治，美国好像在全世界有的是金钱和时间。
例句：Even the best ones can be foiled, though, by a sufficiently willful programmer committed to ignoring basic principles of memory management.
但是，即使最优秀的编程人员也可能会被忽略内存管理基本原则的非常任性的编程人员搅乱。

worthiness
n. 价值,值得
短语：credit worthiness — 信贷可靠性；信誉；信贷价值
例句：So we must ask what lends objective worthiness to a life outside the moral realm.
所以在道德范畴之外，我们必须设问，是什么东西带给人生客观性的值得。
例句：Some find popularity and artistic worthiness to be opposites and therefore, reject bands that become successful.
一些人发现流行程度和艺术价值是对立的，因此否定那些逐步成功的乐队。
例句：Barack and Michelle Obama are also a more fully fused political team than ever before, with no other jobs to distract them, no doubts about the worthiness of the pursuit dogging them.
因为没有其他工作让他们分心，也毫不怀疑他们追求的事业的价值，所以巴拉克和米歇尔·奥巴马比以往任何时候都更加融洽。

moralistic
音标：英 /mɒrə'lɪstɪk/  美 /,mɔrə'lɪstɪk/
adj. 狭隘道德观的, 说教的
例句：It’s difficult to talk to teenagers about drugs without sounding too moralistic.
跟青少年谈论毒品，又不能有太重的说教味道，这是很难的。

conscientious
音标：英 /,kɒnʃɪ'enʃəs/  美 /'kɑnʃɪ'ɛnʃəs/
adj. 认真的，勤勤恳恳的
例句：A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。
例句：a conscientious and hard-working student
勤勉刻苦的学生

syntax
音标：英 /'sɪntæks/  美 /'sɪntæks/
n. 语法, 句法
短语：syntax analysis — 语法分析
短语：syntax error — 语法错误；句法误差
短语：syntax tree — 语法树；句法树
例句：His grammar and syntax, both in oral and written expression, were much better than the average.
无论在口头还是笔头上，他的语法和句法都非常出众。

nonsense
音标：英 /'nɒns(ə)ns/  美 /'nɑnsɛns/
n. 胡说, 废话
短语：talk nonsense — 胡说八道
短语：sheer nonsense — 一派胡言
例句：‘I’m a prisoner in my own home.’ ‘Nonsense!’
“我在自己家里就像个囚犯。”“胡说！”
例句：If you ask me, these modern teaching methods are a load of nonsense (= a lot of nonsense ).
要我说，这些现代教学方法全是一派胡言。
例句：He was talking utter nonsense as usual.
他像平常一样又在胡说八道了。
例句：By 1832 the idea had become an economic nonsense.
到了1832年，那种观点已经成为经济学的谬论。

loudness
n. 大声, 喧闹

terminate
音标：英 /'tɜːmɪneɪt/  美 /'tɝmɪnet/
v. 停止, 终止
短语：terminate a contract — 终止合约
例句：The court ruled that the contract must be terminated.
法庭裁决该合同必须终止。
例句：a woman’s decision on whether or not to terminate the pregnancy
女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

playful
音标：英 /'pleɪfʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'plefl/
adj. 爱玩耍的；幽默的
例句：a playful little dog
活泼的小狗
例句：Babies are playful and alert when they first wake up.
宝宝们刚醒来的时候很好动，而且反应敏捷。

discontinuity
音标：英 /dɪs,kɒntɪ'njuːɪtɪ/  美 /,dɪs,kɑntə'nuəti/
n. 不连续, 中断
例句：discontinuity in economic development
经济发展的间断性

prosaic
音标：英 /prə(ʊ)'zeɪɪk/  美 /prə'zeɪk/
adj. 单调乏味的,平淡的
例句：a prosaic writing style
乏味的写作风格
例句：The reality, however, is probably more prosaic.
然而，事实很可能更平淡无奇。

discrimination
音标：英 /dɪ,skrɪmɪ'neɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /dɪ,skrɪmɪ'neʃən/
n. 歧视；辨别力
短语：racial discrimination — 种族歧视
短语：sex discrimination — 性别歧视；雌雄鉴别
短语：price discrimination — 价格歧视，差别取价
短语：gender discrimination — 性别歧视
短语：race discrimination — 种族歧视
例句：laws to prevent discrimination
防止歧视的法律

vowel
音标：英 /'vaʊəl/  美 /'vaʊəl/
n&a. 元音(的)
短语：vowel sound — 元音声
例句：But he could say vowel clearly and began to learn vocabulary.
但是他已经能清楚地说元音并开始学习词汇。
例句：Always end the name of your child with a vowel, so that when you yell the name will carry.
一定让孩子的名字以元音结尾，这样当你喊叫时，这样的名字会助你一臂之力。
例句：Towards the end of Middle English, a sudden and distinct change in pronunciation (the Great Vowel Shift) started, with vowels being pronounced shorter and shorter.
随着中世纪英语的泯灭，发音突然发生了很大的变化（元音大推移），元音的发音越来越短。
